text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mill a block 10 x 60 x 44 mm; lap the front face flat (Peltier side).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back face (against the shell): two tube sockets 8.1 mm, 5 deep, 25

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side of centre, 10 up from the bottom edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Condensing passage: 6 mm, drilled from the back-side end face, 5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in from the back face and 10 up, through both sockets.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front face: two M3 tapped holes 8 deep, 24.5 each side, 22 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Join the loop tails into the sockets and a 6 mm copper charge stub

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into the passage mouth with aluminium-to-copper brazing rod.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: After charging, the stub is pinched shut and brazed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: back face flat on the shell end, over the slot fillers; held by

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the block frame (CPD-DWG-109). Wrap its edges in foam tape.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: front face flat within 0.05 mm.
